CalendarScan.helper: Reads the next 30 days of your Google Calendar.
CalendarScan.count: {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} in the next 30 days
CalendarScan.empty: No events in the next 30 days.

errors.unauthenticated: Sign in with Google again to scan the calendar.
errors.refreshFailed: The Google sign-in expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: This Google account did not grant calendar access. Sign in again and allow it.
errors.http: Scan failed. Google Calendar returned an error; check the server log.
errors.network: Scan failed. The server could not reach Google Calendar.
errors.schema: Scan failed. The response had an unexpected shape; check the server log.
